# The calling-convention classification suite. Every fn line is one
# row; testdata/<target>.golden holds its lowered declaration per target and
# testdata/clang/<target>.txt clang's lowering of the equivalent C.
#
# Declarations. Structs are laid out in declaration order with natural
# alignment; packed caps alignment at 1,
# packed(n) at n.
struct S1 { a: u8 }
struct S2 { a: u16 }
struct S2b { a: u8, b: u8 }
struct S3 { a: u8, b: u8, c: u8 }
struct S4 { a: u32 }
struct S4f { a: f32 }
struct S4b { a: u8, b: u8, c: u16 }
struct S5 { a: u32, b: u8 }
struct S6 { a: u16, b: u16, c: u16 }
struct S7 { a: [7]u8 }
struct S8 { a: u64 }
struct S8p { p: *u8 }
struct S8r { r: &i32 }
struct S8ff { a: f32, b: f32 }
struct S8d { a: f64 }
struct S8if { a: i32, b: f32 }
struct S8fi { a: f32, b: i32 }
struct S8bf { a: bool, b: f32 }
struct S9 { a: [9]u8 }
struct S10 { a: u64, b: u16 }
struct S12 { a: i32, b: i32, c: i32 }
struct S12f { a: f32, b: f32, c: f32 }
struct S12fi { a: f32, b: f32, c: i32 }
struct S12if { a: i32, b: f32, c: f32 }
struct S16 { a: i64, b: i64 }
struct S16d { a: f64, b: f64 }
struct S16id { a: i64, b: f64 }
struct S16di { a: f64, b: i64 }
struct S16pp { a: *u8, b: *u8 }
struct S16pi { a: *u8, b: i64 }
struct S16ip { a: i64, b: *u8 }
struct S16f4 { a: f32, b: f32, c: f32, d: f32 }
struct S16i8 { a: i64, b: u8 }
struct S16i32 { a: i64, b: i32 }
struct S16i8x { a: i64, b: u8, c: u16 }
struct S16mix { a: u8, b: f32, c: f64 }
struct S16ffd { a: f32, b: f32, c: f64 }
struct S16dff { a: f64, b: f32, c: f32 }
struct S16df { a: f64, b: f32 }
struct S16fd { a: f32, b: f64 }
struct S20 { a: [5]i32 }
struct S20f { a: f32, b: f32, c: f32, d: f32, e: f32 }
struct S24 { a: i64, b: i64, c: i64 }
struct S24d { a: f64, b: f64, c: f64 }
struct S32d { a: f64, b: f64, c: f64, d: f64 }
struct S40 { a: [5]i64 }
struct S40d { a: f64, b: f64, c: f64, d: f64, e: f64 }
struct H1 { a: f32 }
struct H1d { a: f64 }
struct H2f { a: f32, b: f32 }
struct H3 { a: f32, b: f32, c: f32 }
struct H3d { a: f64, b: f64, c: f64 }
struct HArr { a: [4]f32 }
struct HArr2d { a: [2]f64 }
struct HNest { a: H2f, b: H2f }
struct HNest3 { a: H2f, b: f32 }
struct HMix { a: f32, b: f64 }
struct Pk1 packed { a: u8, b: u32 }
struct Pk2 packed { a: u8, b: u64 }
struct Pk3 packed { a: u32, b: u32 }
struct Pk4 packed(2) { a: u8, b: u32 }
struct Pk5 packed { a: u8, b: f64, c: u8 }
struct Pk6 packed { a: u16, b: u8 }
struct Pk7 packed { a: f32, b: f32 }
struct Pk8 packed(4) { a: u32, b: u64 }
# ABI-1: a packed struct nested at an odd offset is aligned relative to
# itself but not absolutely (SysV MEMORY); at an aligned offset it is not.
struct InP packed { x: u32 }
struct OutP { c: u8, i: InP }
struct OutA { c: u8, a: [1]InP }
struct OutP4 { c: u32, i: InP }
struct OutPP packed { c: u8, i: InP }
struct Nest { a: S8if, b: S4f }
struct Nest2 { a: S3, b: u8 }
struct Nest3 { a: S16, b: u8 }
struct Empty {}
struct WithEmpty { a: i32, e: Empty, b: i32 }
struct Bools { a: bool, b: bool }
struct Ch { c: char }
struct ChCh { a: char, b: char, c: char }
struct HasStr { s: str }
struct HasSlice { s: []u8, n: i32 }
struct Arr3 { a: [3]u16 }
struct HasOpt { o: ?&i32 }
struct HasFn { f: fn(i32): i32 }
struct IntPair { a: int, b: uint }
enum E1 { A, B, C }
enum E2: u16 { A, B }
enum E4: u32 { A, B }
enum E8: u64 { A, B }
enum Ei8: i8 { A, B }
enum Ei16: i16 { A, B }
enum Ei32: i32 { A, B }
enum E300 { A, B = 300 }
enum E70k { A, B = 70000 }
enum EP1 { A(i32), B(f32) }
enum EP2 { A(f64), B }
enum EP3 { A(u8, u8), B(u16) }
enum EP4 { A(f32, f32), B }
enum EP5 { A(i64, i64), B }
enum EP6 { A(u8), B }
enum EP7 { A(f32), B(f64) }
enum EP8 { A(*u8), B(i64) }
error Er1
error Er2 { code: i32 }
error Er3 { x: f64 }
error Er4 { a: i64, b: i64 }
error Er5 { a: u8 }

# Rows. p_T passes one T and r_T returns one; then parameter lists that
# exhaust the SysV and AAPCS64 registers, the extension rows,
# zero-sized values, and variadic calls (fixed parameters, then ..., then
# the variadic arguments of one call).
